title: Nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems and their connection to passivity
status: primary mathematical preprint; selected equations inspected
readingDepth: Introduction, definition of passivity and pH-A/pH-B structural assumptions; no full proof audit. v2 dated 16 April 2025.
claim: A nonnegative storage function and conjugate power ports express passivity; skew interconnection and positive-semidefinite dissipation yield an energy inequality.
limits: The cited results have smoothness/model assumptions. A passive numerical realization does not establish the behavior of an uncalibrated device.

title: Nonlinear port-Hamiltonian system identification from input-state-output data (ISO-pHNN)
status: primary computational-method preprint; selected sections inspected
readingDepth: Abstract, introduction and sections 2.1–2.2, including J/R parameterizations and compact-neighborhood Hamiltonian lower-bound caveat. v3 dated 20 August 2026.
claim: The authors identify structured nonlinear dynamics from input-state-output trajectories and report benefits of incorporating prior model structure.
limits: No neural training or author benchmark was reproduced. State access, model class and training-region assumptions matter; this is not a source of energy or an independent experimental conservation test.

title: Identification of Port-Hamiltonian Differential-Algebraic Equations from Input-Output Data
readingDepth: Abstract and introduction/declared contributions. v1 dated 23 January 2026. Full algorithm and proof not audited.
claim: Proposes constrained pH identification from noisy input-output records using an implicit DAE solver, demonstrated by its authors on a DC power network.
limits: Not executed in this project. Reported DC-network performance does not validate a mixed-domain energy apparatus or uniquely identify every hidden parameter.

title: Learnability of Linear Port-Hamiltonian Systems
readingDepth: Official arXiv abstract and version/date metadata only; submitted 28 March 2023.
claim: Describes a structure-preserving identification scheme for SISO linear port-Hamiltonian systems and discusses uniquely identifiable canonical cases.
limits: Full theorem hypotheses and proofs not inspected. Included as a relevant lead, not as a proved identifiability guarantee for the proposed apparatus.

title: Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.TranslationalEMF
readingDepth: Complete short component-description page and revision note; generated 5 June 2020, component initially implemented 2009. Current build-host request timed out; raw versioned-source request failed.
claim: Documents a component that converts electrical energy to translational mechanical energy and connects to the translational mechanics library.
limits: No implementation source inspected and no Modelica simulation run. Historical documentation date must not be presented as a new 2026 research result.
